name: What makes a state trial attorney effective?

mainEntity.name: What makes a state trial attorney effective?

acceptedAnswer.text: An effective state trial attorney knows local laws, builds a strong factual and legal defense, communicates directly with clients, and prepares every case as if it’s going to trial for maximum leverage.
